LanguageData.CC_Settings_TraitChanges_Tip: Now and then, after a long stretch of the same kind of life, one of a colonist's traits grows, appears or fades: steadier nerves after raid after raid held, kindness after years of kindnesses, a pessimist after a year of graves. Each change comes with a letter that tells what led to it, with dates, and is kept on the character page. Rare: at most one change per colonist in 60 days (a trait Rimfolk gave can go sooner), and one in the colony in 10. Traits of the body, sexuality and traits from genes or a backstory never change.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_TraitChanges: Rarely, a trait grows, appears or fades after what a colonist went through.
LanguageData.CC_TC_Absorbed: The trait now holds what had already changed in {PAWN_objective}, so {PAWN_possessive} character stays where it was, and that part of the change is for good.
LanguageData.CC_TC_AbsorbedLost: What the trait held is now counted with what life has changed in {PAWN_objective}, so {PAWN_possessive} character stays where it was.
